```plato

    //==
    // # CheckerTexture
    //
    // The parity of the two tiled coordinates. Floor, not truncation: truncation
    // folds -0.5 and +0.5 onto the same cell and puts a double-width square
    // across the origin.

    // Which of the two colors covers this UV coordinate.
    ColorAt(self: CheckerTexture, uv: UvCoordinate): Color {
        var i = (uv.U * self.Tiling.X).Floor.ToInteger;
        var j = (uv.V * self.Tiling.Y).Floor.ToInteger;
        return (i + j) % 2 == 0 ? self.ColorA : self.ColorB;
    }
```

    // The color of the stop pair bracketing the parameter, blended between them.
    // Positions are assumed non-decreasing; a parameter before the first stop or
    // after the last takes that stop's color.
    ColorAt(self: GradientTexture, uv: UvCoordinate): Color
        => self.Gradient.ColorAtParameter(self.GradientParameter(uv));

    // The opaque grey whose intensity is the remapped noise value.
    ColorAt(self: NoiseTexture, uv: UvCoordinate): Color {
        var intensity = self.NoiseValue(uv) * 0.5 + 0.5;
        return (intensity, intensity, intensity, 1.0);
    }
}
